title: Forum rank checkpoint body
description: The operator commits a period's forum votes and the rank inputs computed from them (register row DK1742; spec-delta S1599; docs/institutions/forum-mechanisms.md 4): `votes_root` is the Merkle root of the period's vote set (leaves are the votes the forum's store holds; merkle.ts), `rank_sha256` the hash of the computed rank inputs, `votes` how many votes. The votes stay in the forum's store; the log holds only the commitment, so a rank is auditable, a replay from the store must reproduce the hashes, and a voter can prove its vote is in the root with an inclusion proof. Limit: the service could leave a vote out before committing; a voter who finds its vote missing holds the proof that it is absent from the root, and the omission is reportable. Periods are days (YYYY-MM-DD), once each, in order. Chain: none (prev is null).
